known_pitfall_claim: For a vector on the positive y-axis, the real arctangent of its direction angle θ is undefined.
pitfall_counterexample: Take v=(0,1) and θ=π/2. Then v lies on the positive y-axis: its x-coordinate is 0 and y-coordinate is 1>0. It has direction angle θ because v=1·(cos θ,sin θ)=(0,1). Nevertheless the real arctangent is the defined real number arctan(π/2).
